第2826章 主动提醒（第1页）
林铭确实是在符箓炼制之上，有一定的本领。
从名字上就可以看的出来，这家宗门是比较重视符咒炼制的。
符咒师加入到符箓宗内，对他们来说，也确实可以算是一个不错的选择！
未来在符箓境界上，说不定能够有一个进一步的提升。
掌柜的叹息了一声，对林铭摆摆手说道：
“贾明，万宝楼的衣服和令牌，你先不用退回来。”
“你若是真的能够加入到符箓宗内，那我们之前所约定的客卿每个月的强制符咒要求就此作废，只是你以后想要销售符咒，或者是有多余的能力炼制更多的符咒的时候，都可以拿来万宝楼，由楼内来帮你进行销售，你可以记住，你依旧是楼内的客卿制符师，楼内也始终都会有你的一个位置，凭借令牌，你无论在万宝楼的任何一个分楼都能够获得九折优惠的福利！”
看得出来，掌柜的对林铭确实是很欣赏。
甚至在这里主动要求保留林铭的福利待遇的！
自己以后想要在万宝楼售卖符咒，就可以前来。
不想售卖，万宝楼也不会对自己有任何强制的要求。
售卖了符咒，得到了一定的贡献点，自己还能够在万宝楼内兑换到一定的物品。
比之在外界之中兑换这东西，可要便宜一些的。
可件数多了，那这数字就并不是一个小数字了。
他也一样没有拒绝掌柜的好意，一口应承了下来。
林铭将纳物袋和令牌收了回来，同时询问者：
“掌柜的，可还有其他吩咐的？！若是没有的话，我就要告辞离开，回去准备一下，明天正式参加升仙大会的升仙任务了。”

掌柜的没有进一步的挽留，更是没有对林铭有其他的想法，任由林铭离开了万宝楼。
从万宝楼内出来，林铭先回到了自己的院落之中，正常修炼和炼制符咒，随后调整了自己的状态，尤其是自己的呼吸。
保证自己处在最好的一个状态之下。
灵力，精神力等等，都调整到了一个巅峰状态！
第二天，养足了精神，早早的向着符箓宗所设置的广场而去！
国都的升仙大会是专门开辟出了几个广场来的。
五个地方，各自开了一个广场，广场的中间按照擂台区，任务区进行了严格的区分！
擂台区是他们要参加擂台赛的那些人，任务区则是有心要走任务路线的人。
在国都之中的人，都要比之在郡城之中的人多的太多了。
林铭到的时候，任务区之中，已然是有着将近一百名散修正在那边进行着炼制！
只是这任务也是刚刚开始，到现在为止，暂时还没有人通过任务考核，成功炼制出极品符咒来。

Chapter 2826 Active reminder (page 1)
Lin Ming indeed had certain skills in refining talismans.
It can be seen from the name that this sect attaches great importance to the refining of spells.
The Talisman Master joining the Talisman Sect is indeed a good choice for them!
In the future, there may be a further improvement in the realm of talismans.
The shopkeeper sighed, waved his hand to Lin Ming and said:
"Jia Ming, you don't need to return the clothes and tokens from Wanbao Tower."
"If you can really join the Talisman Sect, then the monthly mandatory spell requirement for Ke Qing that we agreed on before will be invalidated. However, if you want to sell spells in the future, or if you have extra ability to refine more spells, you can use it. Bao Lou, the building will help you with sales. You can remember that you are still the guest talisman maker in the building, and there will always be a place for you in the building. With the token, you can get a 10% discount in any branch of Wanbao Tower! "
It was obvious that the shopkeeper really admired Lin Ming.
He even took the initiative to ask to retain Lin Ming’s benefits here!
If you want to sell charms in Wanbao Building in the future, you can come here.
If you don’t want to sell, Wanbaolou will not have any mandatory requirements on itself.
After selling the charms, I got a certain amount of contribution points, and I could exchange them for certain items in the Wanbao Tower.
It is cheaper than exchanging this thing in the outside world.
But if there are too many pieces, then this number is no longer a small number.
He also did not refuse the shopkeeper's kindness and agreed immediately.
Lin Ming took back the bag and token, and at the same time asked the questioner:
"Shopkeeper, do you have any other instructions?! If not, I will say goodbye and leave. I will go back and prepare to officially participate in the Immortal Ascension Mission of the Immortal Ascension Conference tomorrow."
The shopkeeper made no further effort to persuade Lin Ming to stay, and had no other thoughts about Lin Ming. He allowed Lin Ming to leave Wanbao Tower.
After coming out of Wanbao Tower, Lin Ming first returned to his courtyard, where he practiced and refined spells as normal, and then adjusted his condition, especially his breathing.
Make sure you are in the best possible condition.
Spiritual power, mental power, etc., have all been adjusted to a peak state!
The next day, I was full of energy and headed towards the square set up by Fu Lu Sect early!
Several squares have been specially opened for the Immortal Ascension Conference in the capital.
Each of the five places has a square. The middle of the square is strictly divided according to the arena area and the mission area!
The arena area is for those who want to participate in the arena competition, and the mission area is for those who are determined to take the mission route.
There are far more people in the capital than in the counties and cities.
When Lin Ming arrived, there were already nearly a hundred casual cultivators refining in the mission area!
It's just that this mission has just begun. So far, no one has passed the mission assessment and successfully refined the best talisman.
